places.name: Todai-ji Temple & Great Buddha
places.ai_summary: A historic temple housing the Great Buddha, a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

opening_hours.notes: Hours may vary during festivals.

places.best_time_to_visit: Spring
places.place_tip: Don’t miss the Nandaimon Gate and the museum nearby.

places.name: Nara Park (Deer Park)
places.ai_summary: A large park where visitors can interact with freely roaming deer, considered sacred in Japanese culture.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited early morning to avoid crowds.

places.best_time_to_visit: Autumn
places.place_tip: Purchase deer crackers to feed the deer, but be cautious as they can be persistent.

places.name: Kasuga Taisha Shrine
places.ai_summary: A famous Shinto shrine in Nara, known for its hundreds of bronze lanterns.

opening_hours.notes: The shrine is open 24 hours, but the main hall closes at 5:30 PM.

places.best_time_to_visit: Late afternoon for sunset views
places.place_tip: Visit during the Lantern Festival in February for a magical experience.

places.name: Kofuku-ji Temple
places.ai_summary: A Buddhist temple in Nara, famous for its five-story pagoda and beautiful gardens.

opening_hours.notes: The temple grounds are open 24 hours, but the museum has separate hours.

places.best_time_to_visit: Spring for cherry blossoms
places.place_tip: Climb to the top of the pagoda for a panoramic view of Nara.

places.name: Naramachi Old Town
places.ai_summary: A preserved historic district in Nara, featuring traditional wooden houses and shops.

opening_hours.notes: Best explored on foot; wear comfortable shoes.

places.best_time_to_visit: Anytime, but shops may close by 5:30 PM
places.place_tip: Visit the Naramachi Mechanical Toy Museum and try the local sweets.

places.ai_summary: A beautiful Japanese garden in Nara, known for its scenic views and tranquil atmosphere.

opening_hours.notes: Last entry at 5:00 PM. Closed in winter.

places.best_time_to_visit: Spring and autumn for foliage
places.place_tip: Enjoy matcha tea at the tea house within the garden.
